The '''2015–16 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team''' represented [[George Washington University]] during the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The [[George Washington Colonials men's basketball|Colonials]], led by fifth year head coach [[Mike Lonergan]], played their home games at the [[Charles E. Smith Center]] and were members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 28–10, 11–7 in [[2015–16 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in fifth place. They defeated [[2015–16 Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team|Saint Louis]] in the second round of the [[2016 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2015–16 Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball team|Saint Joseph's]]. They received an invitation to the [[2016 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]]. As a #4 seed, they defeated [[2015–16 Hofstra Pride men's basketball team|Hofstra]], [[2015–16 Monmouth Hawks men's basketball team|Monmouth]], and [[2015–16 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]] to advance to the semifinals at [[Madison Square Garden]]. At MSG, they defeated [[2015–16 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]] and [[2015–16 Valparaiso Crusaders men's basketball team|Valparaiso]] to become the 2016 NIT champions.

On September 17, 2016, following an investigation into allegations of verbal abuse of his players, head coach Mike Lonergan was fired.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/colleges/gw-officials-are-silent-amid-reports-of-basketball-coach-mike-lonergans-firing/2016/09/17/836161ae-7cf1-11e6-ac8e-cf8e0dd91dc7_story.html |title=Mike Lonergan is out as GW basketball coach after investigation into verbal abuse |newspaper=The Washington Post |date=2016-09-17 |accessdate=2022-06-08}}</ref> He finished at George Washington with a five-year record of 97–70.

==Previous season==
The [[2014–15 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team|Colonials]] finished the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2014–15 season]] 22–13, 10–8 in [[2014–15 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in a three way tie for sixth place. They advanced to the quarterfinals of the [[2015 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] where they lost to [[2014–15 Rhode Island Rams men's basketball team|Rhode Island]]. They were invited to the [[2015 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2014–15 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Pittsburgh]] in the first round before losing in the second round to [[2014–15 Temple Owls men's basketball team|Temple]].
